title: New query_error_to_string is a byte-identical copy of notification_dispatch.debug_query_error
detail: The pog.QueryError stringifier now exists in three private copies. The matching one is private so the diff can't import it, but no public shared helper exists either.
recommended_fix: Promote one to a public helper (e.g. response_helpers or a pog_helpers module) and have webhooks + notification_dispatch + scoring_gate call it.
